_doc: The skinned humanoid bodies (T-091, docs/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md). Read by tools_src/blender/characters/*.py (which build the GLBs) and by ZombieBody (which loads them). part_keys: the material key of every non-skin vertex, stored as COLOR_0.r = index / 255 in the GLB; the colours / roughness / metallic / emission of a key live in ZombieBody.KEY_LOOK and KIT_CLOTH (unchanged). kit_order: bit i of a body vertex's coverage mask (COLOR_0.b = bits 0-7 / 255, COLOR_0.a = 0 when bit 8 is set) means kit i covers it and the merge drops that skin triangle.

lod._doc: mode auto (default): Godot's mesh LODs (ImporterMesh.generate_lods on the merged two-surface mesh, picked per screen size, no extra nodes or draw calls); none: no LODs (the bench A/B, `-- --body-lod=none`). The GLBs also carry scripted Body_LOD1 / Body_LOD2 (lod1_ratio / lod2_ratio) for tools; they are not swapped at runtime (docs/gravelight/PERFORMANCE.md, T-091).

hair._doc: Hair object per kit and sex (Hair_m short crop, Hair_f drawn back into a bun, "" bald / covered). Default Hair_m / Hair_f.
